name: Slice 4: Component list and per-entity editing in an entity tab
body:
# Slice 4: components in an entity tab

An entity tab shows the entity alone in a preview (its template drawn by the editor's preview renderer) with a component
list (the inspector's groups as components: transform, collider, light, script properties and so on) and edits through the
details panel. Any change the engine or the backend needs goes on a card first.
